from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Literal, Optional

class JudicialDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single judgment document and its legal classification features."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document title, e.g. '《判决文书 1》'")
    legal_domain: Literal["Administrative", "Civil", "Criminal"] = Field(description="The broad legal domain of the case")
    primary_legal_issue: str = Field(description="The specific legal cause or action identified in the document (e.g. 'Administrative Reconsideration', 'Criminal Compensation')")
    key_parties: Optional[str] = Field(description="Brief description of key parties if relevant (e.g. 'Plaintiff vs Environmental Bureau')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for the extracted features of all judgment documents."""
    documents: List[JudicialDocument] = Field(description="List of all judgment documents extracted from the collection")
